determinism_gate: serial (first teacher query per root, B=64) and two 25-worker B=64 runs: identical canonical fingerprints on shared queries; the independent B=8 run equals the nested first-8 accounting; interrupt + resume reproduces the uninterrupted B=8 run

label_rule.consistency: no 1->0 flip from B to a larger budget (else BLOCKED: inconsistent scheduling)
label_rule.uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval, reported with every point estimate

negative_diversity_gate.on_fail: confidence-quality gate BLOCKED -> NOT_READY_TO_LAUNCH (no post-hoc roster expansion)

nested_accounting: budget B = the first B scheduled pairs of the 64-pair FULL run (same per-pair seeds and counted work); cross-checked by an independently executed B=8 run

reference.meaning: pilot comparison reference only; NOT exhaustive physical truth; a 64-pair zero stays policy-limited

roster.content: 25 train roots (5 per class, distinct lineage groups), 300 teacher queries + static-ineligible contrasts

safety_gate_25_workers: both 25-worker 64-pair runs finish without a safety cancel, peak Tctl < 95 C, no memory / swap / disk breach; else NOT_READY_TO_LAUNCH_25_WORKERS

workload_rule.disk_budget: free disk at decision time minus a 1,536 MB reserve (runner cancels below 1,024 MB free)
workload_rule.projection: CPU per query from the 25-worker pilot (screen CPU + per-attempt CPU of the first B pairs, or through the first verified pair for FIRST_SUCCESS), mixed by the quota's block / destination composition; wall = CPU / sustained worker-CPU throughput measured in the 25-worker soak (thermal pauses included); disk = measured packed bytes per query
workload_rule.select: first ladder entry inside both limits; none -> NOT_READY_TO_LAUNCH with the required resources
